newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chesterfield mulls buying flour mill.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield mulls buying flour mill.

text.p: Property investment and food manufacturing group Chesterfield Ltd said on Monday it was in talks to buy a flour mill from third parties.
"The company is currently in discussions with third parties with respect to a possible acquisition of a flour mill by the company," it said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange.
"However, discussions are still ongoing and no binding agreement has been entered into," it said, adding "the proposed acquistion may mor may not proceed."
Shares of Chesterfield rose HK$0.019 or 9.5 percent to HK$0.219 in late morning on Monday.
